ANDIRIT-CI1A-S2.6-WP-S61-IMPL-01 evidence package.

Contents
--------
* `preflight.txt` — the Git-object-derived preflight receipt (re-generated by `preflight-receipt.py`).
* `contract-gate.txt` — the contract-consistency gate receipt (re-generated by `contract-gate.py`).
* `environment-windows.txt` — the Windows x64 execution environment and the pinned native dependency identity.
* `environment-ubuntu.txt` — the genuine hosted Ubuntu x64 environment identity.
* `case-receipts/` — the Q-01…Q-12 and post-commit-regression receipts plus the machine-readable case summary.
* `suite-receipts/` — the four suite logs, the whole-solution log, and the format, build and pack logs.
* `coverage/` — the four local Cobertura coverage reports.
* `api-surface/` — the baseline and implementation public API dumps and their diff.
* `dll-comparison.txt` — the compiled-program comparison (types, signatures, IL) of the three production assemblies.
* `package-comparison.txt` — the entry-by-entry comparison of the rebuilt `Andirit.LatticeDb.0.2.0-preview.7.nupkg`.
* `production-delta.diff` — the exact `src`/`tests`/`.github` delta against the baseline.
* `hosted/` — the raw CI job logs (implementation and baseline), the CI artifact index, the raw hosted coverage artifacts and the independently derived hosted result.
* `tools/` — the two comparison tools (`apidump`, `dllcompare`) and the re-runnable drivers.
* `manifest.json` — the self-excluding SHA-256 manifest.

Re-generation
-------------
`run-cases.ps1` (qualification matrix), `preflight-receipt.py`, `contract-gate.py`,
`environment-receipt.py`, `hosted/derive-hosted.py`, `hosted/environment-ubuntu.py` and
`make-manifest.py`.

Sealing
-------
The package was sealed in two transparent steps, both auditable in the Git history:

1. the Windows seal, committed with the implementation revision `01624943233f16447c3176b7c905c544642dfb2c`
   (49 entries);
2. the final seal, committed with the evidence commit that adds the genuine hosted Ubuntu x64
   evidence (61 entries). The manifest is regenerated over the final package content, so the
   manifest always describes exactly the files it ships with.

Byte preservation
-----------------
The `.gitattributes` in this directory marks every file as binary (`-text`), and applies the rule
to itself and to `.gitignore`, so the committed bytes are the bytes the manifest hashes and a fresh
checkout reproduces them verbatim on every platform and with `core.autocrlf` on or off.

The manifest is **self-excluding**: `manifest.json` is not listed among its own entries. Integrity is
verified against the Git blobs of a revision, not against a working tree, by
`preflight-receipt.py` and by the independent verifier used during the commission.
